name: BACH_0161_FSIM_stain3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (92%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Stain-degraded simulated frozen section triggered drafted recut and deeper-level orders, with margins deferred [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 92%, Invasive 5%, Benign 3%, Normal 0% [F1] | Favors InSitu; 5% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} (10% alpha, 90% coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 49% reliability (flagged), 64% OOD [F6] | Suspect stain-degraded input; lower trust |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models split |
| Similar cases | 4/5 InSitu (80%) [F5]; 1 Invasive (89%) | Neighbors mostly match InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 6) · context · Below-typical score (+0.32 toward invasive; 8/20 AI-checked) [F2] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical confinement (-0.32; 12/20 AI-checked) [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Typical score (-0.15; 0/20 AI-checked) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Reduces invasive score (-0.14; 0/20 AI-checked) · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 3, 6) · ↑ invasive · Increases invasive score (+0.12; 3/20 AI-checked) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable mitoses, normal lobules, and necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Severe stain degradation (level 3) obscures invasion, explaining 49% reliability (AUROC 70%) and CONCH–MUSK disagreement.
- Focal invasion or pleomorphism exists in regions 7–9, matching invasive contrast case BACH_0138 (89% similarity).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (5% and 8% invasive risk) for occult invasion or stain artifact.
2. **Regions 7, 11**: Check highest validated pleomorphism (18/20) and stromal-invasion (19/20) scores against contrast case BACH_0138.
3. **Regions 4, 5, 6**: Verify intact duct boundaries and review drafted recut/deeper levels before calling margins.
